script_text: CAPRICORN — Saturn rules your Earth sign, and this week it's tightening its grip, demanding strategy over patience. Midweek, Venus enters your 5th House of love, trining Jupiter in your 4th House, igniting a passionate home connection that heals emotional walls. The weekend shifts dramatically as Mars aligns with your ruling planet Saturn, bringing career momentum — a hidden opportunity surfaces Sunday that reshapes your professional path. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, unlocking creative confidence and romantic clarity. Thursday is your worst day — Sun square Saturn tension peaks, testing your resolve at work. Delegate one heavy burden this week and let Saturn reward your discipline. Follow for daily updates.
